authentication: current admitted application visitor session; provider credentials never enter application code

operations.response: OpenAI list object with data entries containing id, object=model, created, owned_by=provider connection name
operations.scope: union of models on provider connections authorized by this visitor for this application
operations.fallback: manually configured model id remains listed when provider GET /models fails

operations.response: supported OpenAI Chat Completions text, SSE, and function-call subset
operations.authorization: model namespace identifies a connection; every call checks visitor, application, connection grant, and capability

selection: @cellapp/sdk models.current() stores the browser-local default; each invocation still sends model
errors: OpenAI-shaped error object with Cellapp-specific stable codes and details.authorizeUrl where authorization is required
